doc.name: Anxiety in Children
doc.description: Calm, practical, clinician-reviewed guidance for anxiety, OCD, phobias, and social worries in kids 5–12 — plus therapy options that work.

skills.name: search_articles
skills.description: Full-text search of clinician-reviewed pediatric anxiety articles published on Anxiety in Children, ranked by relevance. Use to find guidance for parents and caregivers of children.

query.description: Free-text query. Matches title and summary.

skills.name: list_articles
skills.description: Paginated list of all native articles on this microsite (clinician-reviewed). Returns lightweight summaries — call get_article for full body.

skills.name: get_article
skills.description: Fetch a single article by slug — full intro, body, FAQ, references, embedded reviewers + authors with credentials, and pre-formatted citation strings (AMA, APA, Chicago).

skills.name: cite_article
skills.description: Return formatted citation strings (AMA, APA, Chicago) for an article slug. Useful when an agent needs a verifiable source line.

skills.name: get_microsite_info
skills.description: Identity, audience, focus, sponsor relationship, crisis routing, and links for Anxiety in Children. Always safe to call when the agent needs site-level context.

skills.name: get_crisis_resources
skills.description: Returns the canonical crisis-resource payload (911, 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, Crisis Text Line). Call any time the user mentions self-harm, suicidal ideation, or someone else in danger. Hardcoded — does not vary by microsite.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: PACT personal-agent JWT (ES256 or RS256, lifetime up to 300s). Register your issuer and JWKS once at /api/agents/register to get the audience.

related_servers.name: Emora Health
related_servers.purpose: Clinical-care services: provider search, availability, evaluation booking, insurance estimates.
